name: How often should I have my roof vents assessed?

mainEntity.name: How often should I have my roof vents assessed?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is generally recommended to have your roof vents assessed as part of your overall roof inspection, ideally every 1-3 years, or immediately if you notice any signs of ventilation problems or after a major weather event. Regular maintenance helps ensure optimal performance and can prevent minor issues from becoming costly repairs. Contextual relevance: Given the severe weather patterns common in the DFW area, more frequent checks after storms are particularly advisable to ensure vent integrity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Assess roof vents every 1-3 years with a full roof inspection, or after noticing issues or major DFW weather events.
